title: Phx.tools
description: Archived shell script that set up an Elixir and Phoenix development environment on Linux and macOS. The website and hosted installer have been retired; the MIT-licensed source is preserved for reference.
short_description: Archived Elixir and Phoenix environment setup script. Website and hosted installer retired.

title: Prati.ba
description: Bosnian news aggregator website that collects and curates news articles from various sources, including local news outlets and international media. The website provides news on a variety of topics, including politics, sports, business, culture, and entertainment, among others.
short_description: Bosnian news aggregator covering politics, sports, business, culture, and entertainment. Curating the best local content in one place.

title: StoryDeck
description: StoryDeck is a cloud-based video production tool that offers a range of features for content creators. It allows users to store and archive all their content in one location, track tasks and collaborate easily with team members, and use a multi-use text editor to manage multiple contributors. The platform also offers a timecode video review feature, allowing users to provide precise feedback on video files and a publishing tool with SEO optimization capabilities for traffic-driving content.
short_description: Cloud-based video production tool with content storage, task tracking, multi-user editor, timecode review, and SEO-optimized publishing.
